gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed brain glioblastomas located in a surgically accessible brain region for resection

candidate_evidence.quote: The idea of the present study is to investigate the antitumor effects of SDT in patients affected by HGGs attained with low-frequency Focused Ultrasound.
5-Aminolevulinic Acid: SDT treatment with 5-ALA using the ExAblate Model 4000 Type-2 "Neuro-System".

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: patients with newly diagnosed cerebral glioblastomas

role_evidence.quote: 5-ALA can exert sono-dynamic effects against HGGs, as it has been shown in several preclinical studies.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: sonodynamic activation of 5-ALA-derived PpIX by low-frequency focused ultrasound causing cytotoxic events in the target tissue

coder_notes: Drug-device therapy (ExAblate focused ultrasound activates 5-ALA); antitumour hypothesis stated, not fluorescence-guided resection only.
